title: Rejecting My Five Female Mates
description: A werewolf-romance vertical series that flips the usual fated-mate setup: an alpha stands between five potential mates, rejecting pack expectations at every turn.
descriptionMore: Set in a shifter world built on pack hierarchy and fated bonds, the series follows an alpha who refuses to simply accept the mate the pack has chosen — turning away one potential match after another and setting off tension across pack politics, rivalries, and his own chain of command. Told in short, vertical episodes built for binge viewing.
